plan.bed: a scratch copy (stagekit.Stage.scratch) of a small claudeDev VI holding one While Loop, one Add, one Case, one Flat Sequence, two panel controls - created and deleted in the run

inputs.call: call it on the scratch bed against a known object (class/uid from the bed's graph JSON)
inputs.predict: rows equal the offline graph read of the bed (same uids)

predicted.note: no postcondition (none - read-only query: returns LabVIEW's own listing; no count is expected without the caller's plan (the caller's census / step diff judges it)); predicted = returns without exception, outcome ok

plan.outcome_contract: none - read-only query: returns LabVIEW's own listing; no count is expected without the caller's plan (the caller's census / step diff judges it)
plan.pass_if: every input's prediction holds AND the call's standard outcome is the predicted one; handle count flat (+-100) over the run
plan.runs_in: card chat-F3 (real LabVIEW); never this card

legacy_evidence.note: folded from scratch_verify: no source md5 recorded, so never a FRESH pass
